classes/foe-hunter-612.name: Hated Enemy
classes/foe-hunter-612.description: At 1st level choose one creature type already selected as a favored enemy to become the hated enemy. This choice is irreversible.

classes/foe-hunter-612.name: Rancor
classes/foe-hunter-612.description: Once per round, before the attack roll, designate one attack against the hated enemy as a rancor attack. A successful attack deals +1d6 extra damage at 1st level, increasing to +2d6 at 3rd, +3d6 at 5th, +4d6 at 7th, and +5d6 at 9th. The extra damage is not multiplied on a critical hit and applies even against a hated enemy immune to critical hits. With a sap or unarmed strike it can deal subdual damage.

classes/foe-hunter-612.name: Hated Enemy Damage Reduction
classes/foe-hunter-612.description: Beginning at 2nd level, reduce damage from each successful attack made by the hated enemy by 3 points. This improves to 5 at 4th level, 7 at 6th, 9 at 8th, and 11 at 10th. This damage reduction does not stack with other damage reduction.

classes/foe-hunter-612.name: Hated Enemy Spell Resistance
classes/foe-hunter-612.description: Beginning at 4th level, against spells and spell-like abilities that directly affect the Foe Hunter and originate from the hated enemy, gain spell resistance equal to 15 + Foe Hunter class level. This stacks with other applicable spell resistance.

classes/foe-hunter-612.name: Death Attack
classes/foe-hunter-612.description: At 10th level make a death attack against a hated enemy denied its Dexterity bonus to AC. This functions like the assassin death attack except that it requires only a melee attack that successfully deals damage, not a sneak attack.
